steps.content: The last shadow disappears. Without the monsters, Lisa finally gets a clear look at the Gate of Hell.
Saying that, Lisa turns back, but the one wearing blue is no longer within five meters.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: If you are looking for the visitor named McQueen, she has already left.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: Now please let me continue to introduce you to the collection of this exhibition. The Gate of Hell was designed to reflect people's deepest fear and was one of my favorite works when I was young...
Lisa doesn't talk back to the machine calling herself a beautiful artist this time. She just stands in place as if waiting for something to happen after the navigator finishes her speech.
But no one will show up to pitch a deal to her this time. She stands in front of the gate, examining the carving patterns and feeling the artist's thoughts and struggles.
Just as Lisa is in thought, a tingle pulls her back. Familiar red spikes appear in her palm.
It would be nice to study the work, but Lisa knows she has wasted too much time.
She reaches out and finally pushes open the ice-cold Gate of Hell.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: So that MBCC Chief is really here... It's bad enough that the <color=#fb9259>forgery project</color> almost got exposed. I don't want any more trouble.
In the corner of the underground parking lot, McQueen sits in the driver's seat of a pickup truck and watches Lisa disappear behind the Gate in the reflection.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Sorry, Miss Lisa. I'll have to leave without saying goodbye.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: It's a pity I didn't get a chance to copy <color=#fb9259>Sosia</color>, but today... was worth it.
McQueen steps on the gas, and the truck rolls away carrying a variety of convincing artworks.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: You are leaving Belphegor Art Museum.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: Thank you for visiting Witching Hour.
